items: 【Modular Buffet Cabinet with Storage】This wooden storage cabinet (15.75"D x 92.63"W x 34"H) consists of three credenza storage cabinet offering ample interior storage space. It features an adjustable wooden shelf that can be set to three different heights, giving you the flexibility to customize the space for books, dinnerware, or small appliances. For safe handling: Always lift and carry the cabinet with two people during setup or repositioning to prevent injury or damage

【Elegant Symmetrical Fluted Arched Cabinet】 Credenza features meticulously carved arched fluted panels that create captivating light and shadow effects, adding a touch of modern artistry to your living space. This mid-century modern storage cabinet not only boasts exquisite aesthetics but also offers a delightful tactile experience. It effectively resists fingerprints and minor scratches, maintaining a pristine appearance with ease

【Sturdy and Durable Sideboard】Designed with 5.7 inches of clearance at the base to allow robot vacuums to clean underneath easily. Crafted from high-density wood, it offers both scratch resistance and easy cleaning. It includes anti-tip kits to prevent tip-over accidents and comes with protective Foot Pads to stabilize the unit and guard your floors. With its reinforced frame, this cabinet is built to hold heavy items securely, offering dependable storage for any room

【Adapts to Any Space】This accent sideboard cabinet is adaptable to various rooms, serving as a serving station during meals, a display area for decorations, or a storage unit. Whether for your dining room, living room, entryway, or hallway, it functions as a sideboard, kitchen storage cabinet, TV console, or coffee bar, meeting diverse storage and display needs while enhancing the room's functionality and aesthetics

【Easy to Assemble & Services】Three Sideboards are shipped in two packages and may arrive on different days! Thickened foam and wooden protective panels provide comprehensive protection for all components throughout shipping. Each part is clearly labeled, With just 1.5 hours and 1-2 adults, you can easily complete this installation task. Should you have any questions about assembly or the product, our customer service team will respond within 24 hours to provide a satisfactory solution!
